alt.en: 30-second Verimots promo; the on-screen words are French. A green baize table, a wooden rack, letter tiles that carry their points. "Contestation ?" (a challenge): KAWA lands on the rack and is stamped VALABLE (valid), with its definition "(familier) Café." (slang for coffee, from Wiktionary); then VOX is stamped NON VALABLE (not valid); "Verimots settles it in a second." "Quel est le top ?" (what is the top play?): the rack K O B X E U J, "your turn to look…", then the tiles line up as JUKEBOX: 84 points, 34 points plus a 50-point bonus for using all 7 tiles; next JEUX 20, BOXE 15, BOX 14, KOB 14. "Practise the 7 + 1": AEINRST plus a gold U, 14 eight-letter words from ASTURIEN to URINATES; also blanks, expensive letters, 7 or 8 letters, a timer. "The 81 two-letter words" as a grid of tiles, "Each day, revise the two- and three-letter words, with their definitions." "Four languages, offline too": French 407,128 words, English 257,218, Spanish 608,169, Catalan 584,095; free, no ads, web and Android. VERIMOTS on the rack, "Les mots, à vous de jouer." (words, your move), "Jouer gratuitement" (play for free), verimots.pfa87.cc; independent, not affiliated with Scrabble, Mattel or Hasbro.

reddit.body:
30-second demo (in French): https://verimots.pfa87.cc/promo/

Verimots checks a word (with its definition), finds the top play on a rack using tile points and the 50-point bonus for all seven tiles, and has practice modes: 7 + 1, blanks, expensive letters, 7 or 8 letters, a timer, and the two- and three-letter words. French, English, Spanish and Catalan, offline once the lists have loaded.

The French list is a community list, not the official ODS Larousse edition; English offers a CSW-style public list and WOW24. Verimots is independent and not affiliated with Scrabble, Mattel or Hasbro.

https://verimots.pfa87.cc/

notes: The video's words are in French.

Word counts are those of the lists shipped with Verimots on 26 September 2026: French 407,128 (community list, not the official ODS Larousse edition; 81 two-letter and 639 three-letter words), English CSW-style 257,218, Spanish RLA-ES 608,169, Catalan DISC 584,095. The app's Petits Mots screen shows ten 2-letter and twelve 3-letter words a day; the full lists come from the search by length.

Every word shown was checked against the French list: KAWA is in it, VOX is not; the rack BEJKOUX's top is JUKEBOX (J8 U1 K10 E1 B3 O1 X10 = 34, plus the 50-point bonus for seven tiles = 84, the app's own scoring: face values, no board squares), then JEUX 20, BOXE 15, BOX 14, KOB 14; AEINRST + U makes exactly 14 eight-letter words (ASTURIEN, INSATURE, INSTAURE, RUINATES, RUSAIENT, SATINEUR, SATURNIE, SUINTERA, TAURINES, TISANEUR, TUNERAIS, URANISTE, URANITES, URINATES).
The KAWA definition shown is the app's own /api/define answer, from Wiktionnaire.
Verimots is not affiliated with Scrabble, Mattel, Hasbro, NASPA or ODS Larousse.
